# Completion Report: Work Order 1 — Op Log (`pr-07-v2-storage-wo1`)

## Summary of Completed Work

1. **Op Types & Models ([`internal/core/ops/op.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.hLvQCxE9RE/repo/internal/core/ops/op.go)):**
   - Defined `OpType` string enum: `add`, `amend`, `supersede`, `retire`, `move`, `split`.
   - Defined `Op` struct with fields `Type`, `EntryID`, `DossierScope`, `Timestamp`, `Source`, `SessionID`, and `Fields`.
   - Defined `OpBatch` struct with fields `Version` (starts at 1), `BatchID` (ULID), `CreatedAt`, and `Ops`.

2. **Validation Rules ([`internal/core/ops/validate.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.hLvQCxE9RE/repo/internal/core/ops/validate.go)):**
   - Implemented `ValidateOp` with validation rules per op type:
     - `add`: requires `EntryID`, `DossierScope`, and `Fields` (with at least `text`).
     - `amend`: requires `EntryID` and `Fields`; `DossierScope` is optional.
     - `supersede`: requires old `EntryID` and `Fields` containing `new_entry_id` and `text`.
     - `retire`: requires `EntryID` and `Fields` containing `reason`.
     - `move`: requires `EntryID` and `Fields` containing `to_dossier`.
     - `split`: requires `DossierScope` and `Fields` containing `new_dossiers` (slice of scopes) and `entry_moves` (map of entry ID → new scope).
   - Implemented `ValidateBatch` checking `Version >= 1`, non-empty `BatchID`, non-zero `CreatedAt`, non-empty `Ops`, and validating each individual op.

3. **Op File I/O ([`internal/core/ops/writer.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.hLvQCxE9RE/repo/internal/core/ops/writer.go) & [`internal/core/ops/reader.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.hLvQCxE9RE/repo/internal/core/ops/reader.go)):**
   - `Writer.Write(batch)`: Writes batches as indented JSON to `.memory/ops/<yyyy-mm>/<batch-id>.json`. Creates month directories as needed with atomic write (`os.CreateTemp` + `os.Rename`) to guarantee crash safety.
   - `Reader.ReadBatch(path)`: Reads and validates a single batch file from absolute or relative paths.

4. **Op Log Iterator ([`internal/core/ops/iterator.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.hLvQCxE9RE/repo/internal/core/ops/iterator.go)):**
   - Defined `type Iterator struct`.
   - `Reader.Iterate`: Yields batches in chronological ULID order by walking month directories in order, then files within each month in ULID order.
   - `Reader.IterateAfter`: Yields only batches following the specified batch ID for incremental processing.
   - `Reader.IterateBefore`: Time-cut mechanism yielding only batches where `CreatedAt` is strictly before the commit timestamp resolved via `git log -1 --format=%cI <commit>`.

5. **v1 Events Migration & Deprecation ([`internal/core/ops/migrate.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.hLvQCxE9RE/repo/internal/core/ops/migrate.go) & [`internal/core/events/doc.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.hLvQCxE9RE/repo/internal/core/events/doc.go)):**
   - Implemented `MigrateV1Events(eventsDir, archiveDir string) error` to safely move `.memory/events/` to `.memory/archive/v1-events/`.
   - Added deprecation comment (`// Deprecated: use internal/core/ops instead. Will be removed in WO5.`) to `internal/core/events/doc.go`.

6. **Unit Tests ([`internal/core/ops/ops_test.go`](file:///private/var/folders/3d/3dzd6kf54bv8t8nhbghbmgvc0000gp/T/tmp.hLvQCxE9RE/repo/internal/core/ops/ops_test.go)):**
   - Comprehensive test suite covering `ValidateOp` (all 6 op types + failure cases), `ValidateBatch`, round-trip write/read, `Iterate` across multiple months, `IterateAfter`, `IterateBefore` (both mocked resolver and live git repo), and `MigrateV1Events`. All tests use `t.TempDir()`.
